intent.goal: Grow a controlled SPACE-PRODUCT candidate from relational seeds and compare it with the manually designed baseline.
constraints: Do not remove or bypass Guardian authority.
No self-replication, uncontrolled cloning or authority escalation.
Every correction creates a traceable branch.
Promotion requires evidence and Human Gate approval.
success_criteria: Candidate improves a preregistered capability metric relative to baseline within the same scope.
Controls pass and falsification is attempted.
Repeated evaluation is reproducible within declared tolerance.

hypotheses.claim: GROWER can produce a SPACE candidate with measurable capability improvement while preserving protected invariants.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The candidate does not improve the target capability beyond baseline, or improvement requires an invariant violation.

hypotheses.claim: GROWER can discover a structurally different but admissible SPACE candidate.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Any structural difference is either non-useful or outside the admissible growth boundary.
predictions: Candidate differs in declared structural dimensions

experiments.protocol: Evaluate manual baseline and GROWER candidate under identical task, metric and resource conditions.
Actively search for cases where candidate improvement depends on bypassing or changing protected boundaries.
